title: Parked shelf: a zoomed terminal no longer covers the parked pills
summary: The zoomed terminal in one project's zoom view could reach over the parked strip. The overlap never reproduced in a dev copy, so the zoom area now clips any overflow, with a layout test that pins it above the strip.
lessons_learned: The #551 overlap did not reproduce in a devtest copy across seven window sizes, 3-5 terminals and all parked combinations; if it is seen again, capture a screenshot with the window size and open panels before filing, since the shipped fix is a guard, not a found cause
